add_fpn_ResNet50_conv5_body: add an FPN feature pyramid network onto a ResNet50 backbone model for multi-scale feature extraction
add_fpn_ResNet101_conv5_body: add an FPN feature pyramid network onto a ResNet101 backbone model for multi-scale feature extraction
add_fpn_onto_conv_body: bolt an FPN onto any convolutional backbone by providing a conv body function and level info function
add_fpn_rpn_outputs: add region proposal network outputs on top of FPN feature maps with shared weights across pyramid levels
map_rois_to_fpn_levels: map a set of RoIs to the appropriate FPN pyramid level based on their area using the FPN paper heuristic
